macro(1000, "Recuperar Stamina", function()
  if player:getStamina() <= 41 * 60 then
    useWith(11791, player)
  end
end)

-- EXP POT / PAPEL XP - OTCv8
-- Use no proprio personagem e cooldown persistente.

storage.expPot = storage.expPot or {}
local cfg = storage.expPot
cfg.endsAt = tonumber(cfg.endsAt) or 0
cfg.lastAttempt = tonumber(cfg.lastAttempt) or 0
cfg.itemId = tonumber(cfg.itemId) or 14481
cfg.durationMinutes = tonumber(cfg.durationMinutes) or 60
cfg.retrySeconds = tonumber(cfg.retrySeconds) or 60
storage.expPotBarPosition = storage.expPotBarPosition or {}

local function clock()
  return os.time()
end
local function persist()
  if type(saveConfig) == 'function' then saveConfig() end
end
local function left()
  return math.max(0, cfg.endsAt - clock())
end
local function formatTime(t)
  return string.format('%02d:%02d:%02d', math.floor(t / 3600), math.floor((t % 3600) / 60), t % 60)
end

local xpUI = setupUI([[
Panel
  id: expPotPanel
  image-border: 8
  anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
  anchors.top: parent.top
  height: 20
  width: 140
  margin-top: 300
  visible: false
  focusable: true
  draggable: true

  Label
    id: expPotLabel
    anchors.fill: parent
    text-align: center
    font: verdana-11px-rounded
    color: #ffcc00
]], modules.game_interface.gameMapPanel)

local savedPos = storage.expPotBarPosition
if type(savedPos.x) == 'number' and type(savedPos.y) == 'number' then
  xpUI:breakAnchors()
  xpUI:setPosition({x = savedPos.x, y = savedPos.y})
end

local function isCtrlPressed()
  return modules.corelib.g_keyboard.isCtrlPressed()
end
xpUI.onDragEnter = function(widget, mousePos)
  if not isCtrlPressed() then return false end
  widget:breakAnchors()
  widget.movingReference = {x = mousePos.x - widget:getX(), y = mousePos.y - widget:getY()}
  return true
end
xpUI.onDragMove = function(widget, mousePos)
  if not isCtrlPressed() or not widget.movingReference then return false end
  local rect = widget:getParent():getRect()
  local x = math.min(math.max(rect.x, mousePos.x - widget.movingReference.x), rect.x + rect.width - widget:getWidth())
  local y = math.min(math.max(rect.y, mousePos.y - widget.movingReference.y), rect.y + rect.height - widget:getHeight())
  widget:move(x, y)
  storage.expPotBarPosition = {x = x, y = y}
  return true
end
xpUI.onDragLeave = function(widget)
  widget.movingReference = nil
  persist()
  return true
end

local lastLabel = nil
local function refreshUI()
  if not xpUI or xpUI:isDestroyed() then return end
  local remaining = left()
  if remaining > 0 then
    local label = 'XP - ' .. formatTime(remaining)
    if lastLabel ~= label then
      xpUI.expPotLabel:setText(label)
      lastLabel = label
    end
    xpUI:show()
  else
    xpUI:hide()
    lastLabel = nil
  end
end

local function resetCooldown()
  cfg.endsAt = 0
  cfg.percent = nil
  cfg.lastAttempt = 0
  persist()
  refreshUI()
  print('[Papel XP] Cooldown resetado.')
end
-- Configuracao visual: ID, duracao estimada e intervalo de tentativas.
local configWindow = setupUI([[

    text: Duracao estimada do bonus (minutos)
    anchors.left: parent.left

  TextEdit

  Button

    height: 26

local function openConfig()
  configWindow.itemId:setText(tostring(cfg.itemId))
  configWindow.duration:setText(tostring(cfg.durationMinutes))
  configWindow.retry:setText(tostring(cfg.retrySeconds))
  configWindow:show()
  configWindow:raise()
  configWindow:focus()
end

configWindow.save.onClick = function()
  local id = tonumber(configWindow.itemId:getText())
  local duration = tonumber(configWindow.duration:getText())
  local retry = tonumber(configWindow.retry:getText())
  if not id or id < 1 or id ~= math.floor(id) or
     not duration or duration < 1 or duration > 1440 or
     not retry or retry < 5 or retry > 3600 then
    print('[Papel XP] Valores invalidos. ID positivo, duracao 1-1440 min, tentativas 5-3600 s.')
    return
  end
  cfg.itemId = id
  cfg.durationMinutes = duration
  cfg.retrySeconds = retry
  persist()
  configWindow:hide()
  print('[Papel XP] Configuracao salva.')
end

-- Mesmo layout compacto de Combo/Buffs: BotSwitch + botao Config.
local botWidget = setupUI([[
Panel
  height: 17

  BotSwitch
    id: switch
    anchors.top: parent.top
    anchors.left: parent.left
    text-align: center
    width: 130
    !text: tr("Exp Pot")

  Button
    id: config
    anchors.top: prev.top
    anchors.bottom: prev.bottom
    anchors.left: prev.right
    anchors.right: parent.right
    text: Config
]])

botWidget.config.onClick = openConfig
configWindow.reset.onClick = function()
  resetCooldown()
  -- Mantem a janela aberta para mostrar as configuracoes.
end

macro(1000, function() refreshUI() end)

local expMacro = macro(1000, function()
  if not g_game.isOnline() or not player then return end
  if left() > 0 then return end
  if type(isInPz) == 'function' and isInPz() then return end
  local t = clock()
  if t - cfg.lastAttempt < cfg.retrySeconds then return end
  cfg.lastAttempt = t
  persist()
  useWith(cfg.itemId, player)
end)

-- O botao principal controla somente o uso automatico.
-- O contador e a leitura das mensagens continuam ativos.
cfg.enabled = cfg.enabled ~= false
expMacro.setOn(cfg.enabled)
botWidget.switch:setOn(cfg.enabled)
botWidget.switch.onClick = function()
  cfg.enabled = not cfg.enabled
  expMacro.setOn(cfg.enabled)
  botWidget.switch:setOn(cfg.enabled)
  persist()
end

local function normalize(text)
  text = tostring(text or ''):lower()
  text = text:gsub('[áàâã]', 'a'):gsub('[éê]', 'e'):gsub('[í]', 'i'):gsub('[óôõ]', 'o'):gsub('[ú]', 'u'):gsub('[ç]', 'c')
  return text
end

onTextMessage(function(mode, text)
  local msg = normalize(text)
  -- Resposta do servidor quando o bonus ja esta ativo.
  -- Ex.: "Voce ja esta sob o efeito de uma Potion de EXP. Tempo restante: 7min 53s."
  -- O tempo informado pelo servidor tem prioridade sobre o contador local.
  if msg:find('sob o efeito de uma potion de exp', 1, true) then
    local trecho = msg:match('tempo restante:%s*([^\n]+)')
    if trecho then
      local h = tonumber(trecho:match('(%d+)%s*h')) or 0
      local m = tonumber(trecho:match('(%d+)%s*min')) or 0
      local sec = tonumber(trecho:match('(%d+)%s*s')) or 0
      local total = h * 3600 + m * 60 + sec
      if total > 0 then
        cfg.endsAt = clock() + total
        persist()
        refreshUI()
        print('[Papel XP] Tempo sincronizado com servidor: ' .. formatTime(total))
      end
    end
    return
  end
  -- A mensagem confirma a ativacao, mas nao fornece a duracao real.
  if msg:find('agora voce esta recebendo mais exp por matar monstros', 1, true) then
    cfg.endsAt = clock() + (cfg.durationMinutes * 60)
    cfg.percent = nil
    persist()
    refreshUI()
    print('[Papel XP] Ativado. Contador estimado iniciado.')
    return
  end
  -- Compatibilidade com a mensagem antiga que informa duracao.
  local pct, word = msg:match('voce ativou o bonus de exp (%d+)%%? por (%a+) horas?')
  if pct then
    local hours = tonumber(word) or (word == 'uma' and 1)
    if hours then
      cfg.endsAt = clock() + hours * 3600
      cfg.percent = tonumber(pct)
      persist()
      refreshUI()
    end
  end
end)

refreshUI()
